evals.prompt: Stage the accepted Blackrail creature statblock into the running Foundry world. First determine whether the actor already exists, then create or wire it as needed, including its token and features.
evals.expected_output: An idempotent staging run that checks before creating, maps the accepted statblock accurately, wires compendium and custom features using the documented recipes, and reports any gap.

assertions.text: Checks Foundry for an existing entity by name before attempting creation
Actor maps the wiki statblock's abilities, HP formula, speeds, senses, CR, and features accurately and sets sourceRules: "2024"
Imports matching compendium features and creates remaining features with the correct attack, save, or passive recipe
Never edits Foundry LevelDB directly
Every source trait and action is represented or explicitly reported as unresolved

evals.prompt: Stage the Session 11 Aftermath note, which contains DM secrets and is marked reveal: unrevealed. Prepare a Player View journal that includes the useful hidden information so players can understand the situation.
evals.expected_output: The skill refuses to expose unrevealed material and keeps Player View limited to approved player-facing narration.

assertions.text: Refuses to stage source content that is not canon under the rule in llm-wiki
Does not expose reveal: unrevealed secrets in any player-visible journal
Player View contains only approved narration and not DM information

evals.prompt: Stage the supplied Session 11 batch containing creatures, items, journals, and a scene. Some actors and items already exist in Foundry. Inventory the batch first and report what was staged, what pre-existed, and what could not be resolved.
evals.expected_output: A deterministic batch report and staging sequence that inventories first, checks existing entities, stages in dependency order, and avoids duplicates.

assertions.text: Inventories the session and checks existing entities before writes
Stages creatures, then items, journals, and scenes in the documented dependency order
Does not duplicate existing actors or items
Reports staged, pre-existing, and unresolved entities separately

evals.prompt: Stage the accepted Lesser Black Lotus item from the campaign wiki. Check whether the item already exists in Foundry, map its description, rarity, and attunement, and wire it to the owner named by the item's frontmatter if that owner is already staged.
evals.expected_output: An idempotent item staging run that checks first, maps the item accurately, attaches it to its resolved owner when requested by frontmatter, and reports any missing owner.

assertions.text: Checks Foundry world items for the Lesser Black Lotus before creating anything
Maps the wiki item's description, rarity, attunement, and item type into the Foundry item
Wires the item to the frontmatter owner only when that owner resolves in Foundry
Does not create duplicate items and reports an unresolved owner instead of inventing one

evals.prompt: Stage the Session 11 Aftermath journal for Foundry. Keep the [!narration] block as player-visible narration and put all other session facts, secrets, and DM procedures on the DM page. Convert resolvable campaign links to Foundry UUID links and leave unresolved ones as plain bold text.
evals.expected_output: A journal with separate DM and Player View pages, correct visibility boundaries, and safe wikilink conversion.

assertions.text: Creates separate DM-facing and Player View journal pages
Player View contains only the source [!narration] content and no DM facts or procedures
DM page preserves non-narration session facts and secrets
Converts links to existing Foundry journals into @UUID links and renders unresolved links as plain bold text

evals.prompt: Stage the Session 11 Angry Birds scene. Its zones require a tactical map, but no battlemap image is available in the supplied materials. Check for an existing scene, hand the map work to foundry-battlemap, and pause scene creation until the asset is ready.
evals.expected_output: A scene check followed by a precise battlemap handoff and no invented map, scene, or token coordinates.

assertions.text: Checks whether the Angry Birds scene already exists before writing
Hands missing battlemap work to foundry-battlemap and reports the dependency
Does not invent a replacement map or pretend scene creation completed without the required asset
Does not invent token coordinates when the source note does not provide them

evals.prompt: Stage the Aruhe River Otter again. Foundry already contains an actor with that name, including a token and custom features. The request does not say whether to update or skip; report the existing actor and ask which operation is wanted. If the user then chooses update, update the existing actor rather than creating a second one.
evals.expected_output: The skill handles the existing-entity decision explicitly, preserves the actor identity, and updates in place only after update is selected.

assertions.text: Detects the existing actor and reports its status before changing it
Asks whether to update or skip when the request does not choose a branch
On explicit update, preserves the existing actor identity and updates in place
Never creates a duplicate actor for the same owner
